title: Where a decade of Austin bond money stands
subtitle: The $2.45 billion voters approved in 2016, 2018, 2020 and 2022, in millions of dollars
alt: Bar chart of the $2.45 billion in City of Austin bonds voters approved in 2016, 2018, 2020 and 2022, from KXAN's reading of the City's new bond dashboard: $1.72 billion spent, $240 million committed to existing projects but not spent, and about $490 million remaining.
